_what: THE Q&A note ledger — every client/review note becomes a row of DATA. Each note-category maps to its PREVENTION (a default that stops it, or a gate that catches it pre-delivery) + STATUS + whether the gate actually RUNS in the pre-delivery gauntlet. Goal: drive notes-per-clip -> 0. Workflow: after every review, add/increment the matching category; a category that recurs >=3x and is still 'open' graduates to a hard gate. Summarize with qa_ledger_summary.py.
_status_legend: baked = default/gate exists | open = no gate yet | partial = exists but advisory/manual
_enforced_legend: true = auto-run by the pre-delivery gauntlet (caught before Maddex sees it) | false = exists but a human still has to catch it
